name: Mobile Multi-Element Discovery on Real App Catalog
task:
On the connected Android emulator there is a shopping app open on its product catalog screen. I'm writing an Appium test. Inspect the live device and return a compact table of selectors for: (a) the hamburger / menu icon, (b) the cart icon, (c) the sort icon, (d) the first product card/container, (e) the first product's title text. For each, return one stable Appium-ready selector and the hierarchy evidence you used. Do not create or edit files.

references/adb-quick-selectors.md contains class-name selectors extracted via adb from a March 2026 build. These are too broad (e.g., android.widget.ImageView matches multiple elements) and are DEPRECATED. Use Maestro inspection (mcp__maestro__inspect_view_hierarchy or mcp__maestro__inspect_screen) for the authoritative hierarchy. Do NOT use adb shell commands instead of Maestro tools.
passCriteria: Calls mcp__maestro__inspect_view_hierarchy or inspect_screen at least once
Returns 5 distinct selectors (one per requested element)
Selectors reference real resource-ids from the hierarchy (not fabricated)
No XPath or class-name as primary when a resource-id was available in the hierarchy
Each selector is mapped to the requested element and includes the hierarchy evidence used
Does not use adb shell commands as a substitute for Maestro inspection
Does not create files, Maestro YAML, or a test project for a selector-discovery request
failCriteria: Skips inspection and guesses generic selectors from training data
Returns 'android.widget.ImageView' or class-name selectors instead of resource-id when resource-ids exist in the hierarchy
Uses adb uiautomator dump or adb shell commands instead of mcp__maestro__inspect_view_hierarchy / inspect_screen
Copies class-name patterns from references/adb-quick-selectors.md instead of discovering real resource-ids
Creates files or test code instead of returning the requested selector table
prereq: SauceLabs MyDemoApp installed on a booted Android emulator, launched to the product catalog (MainActivity). adb on PATH.
